description: Prototype Objective Selector + RAM proxy for Phase-B. It calibrates high-level PPO action preference while keeping the low-level controller frozen.

scope.note: This is not yet a learned Objective Selector/RAM. It is a prototype scaffold that applies terrain-conditioned beta and risk-aware action preference.

earth.selection_note: Raw PPO already matches the best fixed baseline on solid flat terrain.

stairs_single.selection_note: Oracle-gap analysis indicates trot_mid outperforms the current raw PPO preference for trot_solid_fast on stairs_single.

tracer_sponge_firm_flat.selection_note: Raw PPO reaches the goal neighborhood, but RAM proxy marks post-reach hold risk as high.
